% trimmarks-banner.tex -- pdfTeX backend banner parity fixture (V2).
% show=banner opt-in under pdfTeX: default (yoko) banner plus
% tate-positioned banners rendered via graphicx rotation
% (\jlreq@trimmarks@pdf@rotatebanner; jlreq-trimmarks-pdftex.def).
% Placement parity target: pTeX (uplatex) ground truth measured on the
% reference banner PDF with pdftotext -bbox:
%   top-left tate  : x[]52.0..59.5] y[86.2..161.5]   (right of left edge,
%                    descending from just below the top side area)
%   top-right tate : x[581.4..588.9] y[86.2..123.8]
%   bottom-left    : x[52.0..59.5]   y[738.2..766.5]
%   bottom-right   : x[581.4..588.9] y[738.2..766.5]
%   in@center-left : x[70.0..77.5]   y[416.9..435.7]
%   in@center-right: x[563.4..570.9] y[416.9..435.7]
% 独立検証: tests/check-banner-slots.py が本PDFの各バナースロットの
% bbox・書き込み方向を固定ジオメトリ窓で機械判定する（自己申告
% typeout は削除済み）。
\documentclass[pdflatex,paper=b5]{jlreq}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage[show={trimmarks,banner}]{jlreq-trimmarks}
\jlreqtrimmarkssetup{
  banner={
    top-left     = { tate = { TATEBANNER-PROBE } },
    top-right    = { tate = { RIGHTTOP } },
    bottom-left  = { tate = { BLTATE } },
    bottom-right = { tate = { BRTATE } },
    center-left  = { in = { CLIN } },
    center-right = { in = { CRIN } }
  }
}
\begin{document}
トンボと回転バナーのテスト。左上に縦読みの日付バナーが出る。
\end{document}
